{{Quote|This time the trouble involves a Rodian spice dealer named Soobu Javeedo, who's foolishly decided to peddle his wares in my territory without so much as a 'by your leave.'|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]]|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
'''Soobu Javeedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Javeedo was found to peddle his wares in the territory of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba. Lady Valarian therefore tasked [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with eliminating the spice dealer. The spacer eventually found Soobu Javeedo and two [[Desert Banshees|Desert Banshee]] [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and killed them in the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ToughThugMaleRodianTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Soobu Javeedo]]
Soobu Javeedo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Soobu Javeedo was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:LV" />

Because Soobu Javeedo spawned under the generic "tough_thug_male_rodian" template, his appearance was randomized under one of eight possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, he systematically appeared as a Rodian and quest dialogues identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:LV" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Soobu Javeedo was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
